definition: right now, at this present time
description: A restaurant kitchen seen from the doorway, through a pair of wooden swing doors with a cloth hanging over one. A young woman chef in a white jacket, her hair in a bun, places food on plates next to a pan of vegetables over a blue gas flame. Behind her a young man in a black apron chops greens. The viewer's hands push on the swing doors, and the chef turns towards the door and holds up her palm. Copper pans hang from a rail, lamps glow over the pass and white tiles cover the walls.
